title: Orders with the customer who placed them
prompt: Return every order alongside the customer who placed it, as `name` and `amount_cents`, ordered by `amount_cents` descending.

files.name: query.sql
files.content:
-- Each order with the customer who placed it.
SELECT
FROM orders

files.name: schema.sql
seed.sql
files.content:
INSERT INTO customers (id, name) VALUES
  (1, 'Asha Rao'), (2, 'Vikram Shah'), (3, 'Leela Menon');

INSERT INTO orders (id, customer_id, amount_cents) VALUES
  (1, 1, 4500),
  (2, 2, 12000),
  (3, 1,  900),
  (4, 3, 8300);
